description:
Through a blend of biblical wisdom and practical insights, listeners are guided through the complexities of acupuncture's origins in Taoist cosmology and astrology. The conversation goes beyond mere prohibition, diving into the essence of spiritual discernment and the call to uphold goodness while shunning evil, as emphasized in 1 Peter 3:11. With Daniel Morikone, Jason Bradley, and Daniel Perrin. Hosted by Ricky Carter. 


Send us your Bible Questions! 
By email: BibleQA@3abn.org 
By text: (618) 228-3975

QUESTIONS COVERED:


1. Should Christians participate in acupuncture? 

2. Since God’s Word says He doesn’t strive with mankind always, does that mean a person’s probation can end at any time during his lifetime? When does one's probation end?

3.  According to Matthew 6:19-21, what are the treasures that we are laying up in heaven? 

4.  Would you please explain Psalm 23:5? 

5.  How do you glorify God? What does glory mean? 

6.   Can you please help me understand Romans 9:22-23? I know God is merciful and just. I believe that those who will not be saved would have chosen to reject Him, but also, in this chapter, it says in verse 18 - "God has mercy on whom He wants to have mercy, and He hardens whom He wants to harden." 

7.  What verses can I use to help people understand that it's not their dead loved ones they are seeing, but demons impersonating them? What verses can I use to support the state of the dead?

8. Could you please explain Timothy 5:23?

9. What happened to the demons after the pigs they entered ran down the hill and died? Did the demons die? If not, where did they go? What happened to the demons in Matthew 8:28-34 after the pigs died?  

10. Has the weekly Sabbath ever changed? 

11. How did the Bible get canonized? Who decided which scriptures to include? When was it done? 

12. Is there a Bible passage that supports the quote, "You cannot give what you don't have."
